limitations: Android emulator development build only; no release-device frame-time improvement claimed.
Real spoken-answer recognition and physical microphone/audio quality require a real device.
Offline queue/reconnect tested; forced server-500 write failures were not injected.

Performance improvement is measured coloring work reduction, not an established FPS increase.
